partner.title: Partner area

guide.title: Guide
guide.intro: Short instructions for each screen. Tap a topic to open it.

area.title: The partner area
area.body:
Guests book online and pay at reception. You run the camping from here, on a phone or a computer, with the same email.
• Today: the reception screen.
• Bookings: requests, upcoming and past stays.
• Profile, Pitch types, Rates, Calendar: the camping's setup. On phones Pitch types, Rates and Team open from Profile.
• Reviews and Team.
On the reception phone, allow notifications so you hear every new booking. If you have two campings, pick one at the top.

setup.title: Profile and Pitch types
setup.body:
Only owners change the setup; staff can view it.
• Profile: name, address, map point (in Google Maps, long-press your entrance and copy the two numbers), descriptions in Greek and English, amenities, check-in and check-out times, photos (the first is the main one).
• Confirmation: Instant, or On request with the hours you have to answer (2–48).
• Cancellation: Flexible, Moderate or Strict.
• Pitch types: one for each kind of pitch, with the equipment it accepts (tent, caravan, camper), maximum people and photos. A Hidden type isn't sold online.
Changes to the name, descriptions and photos show on the website in about 10 minutes.

rates.title: Rates and Calendar
rates.body:
Prices are in euros, VAT included, and each booking's price is worked out automatically. In Rates, in this order:
1. Guest categories by age (e.g. Adult 12+, Child 4–11).
2. Extras (car, electricity, pet) and Fixed fees.
3. Seasons: first and last night, minimum nights. The last night is the night before departure.
4. Each season's prices, then Save prices. An empty field doesn't apply in that season.
In the Calendar each night shows bookings / pitches on sale. Set allotment says how many pitches of each type Antiskino may sell; keep some for phone calls and walk-ins. Closed nights aren't sold online.
Bookings already made keep their price; a new price only affects new ones.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.body:
The nights are held from the moment of booking.
• Request: Accept or Decline by the deadline. With no answer it expires and the guest is told; a reminder comes 2 hours before.
• Confirmed: if needed, Cancel booking with a reason, which the guest sees.
• After departure the booking completes on its own the next day.
Guests can cancel from their email or the app; the nights are freed at once. Search by name or reference (ANT-…) and open Details for the price breakdown and history.

reception.title: Today at reception
reception.body:
Today updates itself: arrivals, departures, who is in house tonight, and requests with the time left.
1. When the guest arrives, tap Check in.
2. In Details, enter the pitch number and, if needed, an internal note (only your team sees it). The red "No pitch assigned" goes away.
3. Take the amount shown as "Pays at the camping" and issue a receipt as always.
If someone doesn't come, tap No-show from the arrival day on. The nights stay held; to sell them again, cancel the booking.

team.title: Reviews, Team, notifications
team.body:
• Reviews: only guests who stayed can write one, from the day after departure. Your reply is public.
• Team: owners invite members by email and role and send them the link (it works once and expires in 7 days). Staff work Today, Bookings and Reviews but can't change Profile, Pitch types, Rates or the Calendar.
• Notifications: every member with the app hears new bookings, requests and cancellations, and gets emails too. Under Account → Booking emails you turn off the emails you don't want.

payment.title: Payment, commission, help
payment.body:
The guest pays the whole amount to you, at reception; Antiskino charges nothing online.
• The commission is the rate we agreed, on each booking's total, and shows in Details.
• It's charged only for completed stays, not for cancellations, declines or no-shows.
• Each month we send you a statement and an invoice.
Something not working, or a price that doesn't match? Send us a screenshot and the booking reference: {{email}}

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use Antiskino (the website and the apps) to find and book camping pitches in Greece. By booking or creating an account, you accept them.

about.title: Who we are
about.body:
Antiskino is run by {{name}}, {{address}}, Tax ID {{taxId}}. You can reach us at {{email}}.

Antiskino is a booking platform. The campings listed are independent businesses: each camping provides your stay, and your contract for the stay is with the camping. We pass your booking to the camping and keep you both informed.

booking.title: Booking
booking.body:
• You must be at least 18 to book, and the details you give must be correct: the camping relies on them.
• Campings with instant confirmation confirm your booking straight away. Others get your request and answer within the hours shown; if they don't, the request expires and nothing is booked.
• Your booking is confirmed only when the confirmation screen or email says so. You get a booking reference and a link to manage it.

prices.title: Prices and payment
prices.body: Prices are in euros and include VAT. The price you see when you book is the price of your booking, even if the camping changes its rates later. You pay the camping at reception; nothing is charged online. Antiskino doesn't charge guests any fee: campings pay us a commission on completed stays.

cancellations.title: Cancellations and changes
cancellations.body:
• You can cancel from My bookings or from the link in your booking email. Each camping's cancellation policy is shown before you book; while you pay at reception, cancelling costs nothing.
• Bookings can't be changed: to change dates, cancel and book again.
• A camping may cancel a booking only with a reason, and we let you know right away.
• If you don't arrive, the camping may handle it according to its own rules.

stay.title: Your stay
stay.body: The camping's own rules and check-in and check-out times apply. Questions about the stay, the pitch or the facilities go to the camping, whose contact details are in your booking.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.body: After a completed stay you may review the camping once. Reviews must be about your own stay and honest, without offensive language, other people's personal data or advertising. Your first name, country and month of stay are shown with them. The camping can reply publicly, and we may hide reviews that break these rules.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: You don't need an account to book. If you sign in, you do so with a one-time code sent to your email, so keep access to your email safe. You can delete your account at any time from the Account tab.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: Campings supply their descriptions, photos, prices and availability, and are responsible for them and for the stay itself. We take care to run Antiskino reliably but can't promise it is always available or free of errors. Nothing in these terms limits your rights as a consumer under the law.

law.title: Complaints and applicable law
law.body: Write to us at {{email}} with any complaint and we'll answer as soon as we can. Greek law applies to these terms, without taking away the protection the law of your country of residence gives you as a consumer. You can also turn to the Greek Consumer Ombudsman or the courts.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms; the date at the top shows the latest version. Bookings follow the terms in force when they were made.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Antiskino uses, why, and the choices you have.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body:
{{name}}, {{address}} (Tax ID {{taxId}}) is responsible for your data on Antiskino. Contact: {{email}}.

When you book, the camping receives your booking details and is responsible for how it uses them to host you.

data.title: What we collect
data.body:
• Booking details: name, email, phone, country, the people and equipment in your party and, if you give them, vehicle plate, arrival time and a note to the camping.
• Account: your email, language and the details you save.
• Favorites, reviews, and your device's token for push notifications.
• For people working at a camping: their email and role in the team, and what they do in the partner area.
• Technical data our providers record, such as IP addresses and request logs, to run the service securely.

purposes.title: Why we use it
purposes.body:
• To make and manage bookings, remind you of them, and send booking emails and pushes (performing the contract you ask for).
• To show your reviews (your choice to publish).
• To keep records of bookings for the campings, the commission and the law (legal obligations and our legitimate interest).
• To keep the service secure and fix problems (legitimate interest).
We don't sell your data, show ads or use tracking cookies.

sharing.title: Who receives it
sharing.body:
• The camping you book, for your stay.
• Providers that process data for us: Supabase (database, sign-in, server functions), Resend (emails), Expo, Google Firebase and Apple (push notifications), GitHub (website hosting and encrypted backups), OpenFreeMap (maps: your device asks it for the map images) and Sentry (error reports, without names, email addresses or links).
Some of them are in the United States; those transfers rely on the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework or the EU standard contractual clauses.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body:
• Bookings: as long as accounting and tax laws require. If you delete your account, your bookings stay without your name, email or phone.
• Account, favorites and devices: until you delete your account (devices also when you sign out).
• Reviews: until you delete your account or we remove them.
• Backups: encrypted, kept for 30 days, so deleted data leaves them within 30 days.
• Provider logs: for short periods set by each provider.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, to restrict or object to its use, and to receive it in a portable format: write to {{email}}. You can also delete your account yourself in the app (Account tab) or on the Delete account page of the website. You have the right to complain to the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr).

device.title: On your device
device.body: The app and the website store your sign-in, language and favorites on your device so that they work. None of it tracks you.

children.title: Children
children.body: Antiskino is not meant for children under 16, and bookings must be made by adults.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We update this page when the way we use data changes; the date at the top shows the latest version.
